description: Use this when a Fantasy Premier League (FPL, fantasy football) manager wants their team rated or reviewed, or shares their team ID or FPL link without saying more. Scores the squad 0-100 against the best possible squad over the next 5 gameweeks and lists the biggest fixes, naming the players; pass their team ID or FPL link, or the player names read from a screenshot of their team.

players.description: 11-15 FPL player names (e.g. read from a screenshot of their team), used when there is no team ID. Add the club to disambiguate, e.g. 'Palmer CHE'.
players.title: Players

team_id.description: The manager's FPL team ID (entry ID), or any FPL link containing /entry/<id>/. Leave empty if unknown.
team_id.title: Team Id

name: rate_my_team
title: Rate my FPL team
